items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Well he signed Aretha to Columbia but it was not successful.

ctx.x: Well he signed Aretha to Columbia but it was not successful. Columbia took her over and tried to make her into a pop singer. It wasn’t ‘til she went to Atlantic. But he told me all those stories, and what a guy. But I talk about it in my class, in 1935 when he convinced Benny Goodman to hire Teddy Wilson, which I said would be equivalent to, I don’t know, whoever’s out there now, Hammond sending a man from Mars. It was front page. Not entertainment section, it was front page. “Goodman Breaks the Color Barrier.”…
Plus they were playing together on recordings, right?
